base: any feasible finite registered raw sensor transducer with observer A and language L_T

refinement.support: E_m(s,z) contains ((y,j),s') for every (y,s') in E(s,z) and every color j
refinement.color_semantics: registered raw label with no effect on q, sensor successor, plant, or actuator

stop_rule: a plant-only forced-raw h_read cannot be canonical until the problem chooses a sensor experiment or an allowed sufficient-statistic quotient
